name: Prague Bubeneč mechanical wastewater treatment
description: Prague’s sewerage system conveyed wastewater to a gravity-fed treatment works that removed solids before discharge into the Vltava.

date.basis: The source reports the date for this scoped event or archaeological context.

events.statement: The Bubeneč wastewater plant entered full operation after trials.

evidence.supports: The Bubeneč wastewater plant entered full operation after trials.
The source attributes this contribution to quido-belsky-company.
The nomination attributes the sewerage system design to Lindley.

earliest_record.rationale: The earliest dated case currently researched, not a claim of the capability’s original invention or global priority.

caveats: 1907 denotes full operation; initial trials were earlier. No claim is made that mechanical clarification removed all pollutants.

research.note: Independent review checked the UNESCO nomination for the 1907 operation date and named contributions. It distinguishes plant construction in 1901–1906 from full operation after trials.
